name: FastAPI review baseline
description: API contracts, validation, dependency boundaries, and testing guidance for FastAPI services.

rules.title: API contract changes are explicit
rules.rationale: Request, response, and status-code changes affect external consumers.
check_statements: Request validation is represented by explicit models.
Response shape and status behaviour are intentional.

rules.title: Route behaviour is tested
rules.rationale: Route-level tests verify validation, dependency integration, and HTTP behaviour.
check_statements: Changed success behaviour has an API test.
Relevant validation and failure responses are tested.
